description: Fixed check of claim_auto_joint_continuation: actual three-node election and implicit joint removal, caught-up transfer overlapping leader application, one lost TimeoutNow, ten regular tick rounds clearing transfer, then a ten-round fully serviced suffix. Compare complete semantic state at suffix boundaries; retain no-transfer and post-observation proposal diagnostics.

harness.description: Serialized RawNode network with synchronous MemoryStorage persistence and actual committed configuration application; read-only recursive state observation and no modified target code.
semantic_changes: MemoryStorage represents durable completion without injecting crashes; application processing records configuration application and otherwise consumes normal entries.
A single emitted TimeoutNow is lost in the selected network policy; subsequent delivery is reliable.
Read-only reflection and JSON event reporting observe private protocol state; logging, storage call statistics and unlocked mutex internals are excluded from recurrence comparison.

legality.derivation: Uses actual NewRawNode initialization from an agreed snapshot (index/term 1, voters 1/2/3) and matching HardState, as supported by RawNode initialization guidance. Campaign, proposals, transfer, all replication and membership application execute real target code. The caller serializes all calls, persists each Ready snapshot/entries/HardState before any outbound delivery, applies committed entries and configurations before Advance, and drains Ready/network work after each tick round. TransferLeader is called after commitment and before applying that Ready configuration, without accepting another Ready; entry persistence has already completed. Exactly the first implementation-generated TimeoutNow is dropped; every subsequent message is delivered, and all nodes receive ticks. MemoryStorage substitutes completed durable writes in a no-crash execution. RawNode starts no goroutine and needs no Stop. No existing test helper or private protocol write is used.
legality.applicability: Principal input is overlap=true and an implicit removal of node 3, retaining voters 1 and 2. The identical no-transfer case is an independently selected diagnostic control, not a second formal requirement. Admission requires actual joint application, transfer active, one loss and drained work. Later proposal rescue occurs strictly after the compared suffix.
alternatives: Read-only reflection captures live target state into independent JSON strings. It excludes only logger/traceLogger, MemoryStorage.callStats and MemoryStorage.Mutex; no protocol bookkeeping is omitted. Slice capacity and allocation addresses are not logical state; objects are not replaced during the heartbeat-only suffix.

Global election randomness is not sampled during the selected suffix: messages must all be heartbeat/response, role remains leader, all state including follower election counters and randomized timeouts is compared, and source tick/reset paths govern any election. If these conditions do not hold, cycle_closed is false and no recurrence violation is claimed.

grounding.derivation: Under claim_auto_joint_continuation, an implicit joint configuration whose transfer blocker has cleared cannot remain in a closed recurrent suffix of reliable ticks and serviced work while AutoLeave remains true. The monitor compares a measured repeatable-cycle condition against the actual live AutoLeave state. cycle_closed requires equality of recursively captured protocol/storage/caller states, drained work after every round, heartbeat-only delivered traffic and stable leadership. The trace and before/after strings are retained for correspondence review. The deterministic suffix is ten Tick-all-nodes-and-drain rounds; its size is a witness period, not an exit deadline. No additional input is needed to repeat this suffix.
grounding.applicability: Only overlap=true is formally selected, before outcomes are known. Result correlates to the admitted applied change by case_id and config_index, with a separately witnessed clear-transfer starting point. A failed recurrence condition is only absence of this witness, not proof of eventual exit.
alternatives: No-transfer exit and later proposal-triggered exit are retained diagnostics and cannot suppress a violating recurrent witness.
A finite period alone supplies no liveness deadline; the result depends on state closure and complete trigger analysis.
No cluster safety or inability to commit ordinary work is claimed.

observable_properties.description: A fully accounted recurrent suffix after the temporary transfer blocker clears must not retain the applied implicit joint AutoLeave state. Recurrence is measured from target/caller state, not inferred from a finite timeout. A nonclosed suffix only fails to exhibit this witness.

uncertainties: This single selected synchronous no-crash history does not cover async storage, restart or other configurations.
Formal violation attribution depends on semantic review of the state projection and deterministic repeated suffix; passing the Go test is not the oracle.
The diagnostic proposal intentionally introduces extra caller work after the observation; its recovery cannot satisfy the prior automatic-continuation duty.
